question.text: Meher Foundation CSR Trust (corporate CSR arm of a listed parent) had a CSR obligation of INR 5 crore for FY 2024-25, against an ongoing multi-year education project for Roshni Trust. It spent INR 3.8 crore during the year on the ongoing project and carried forward INR 1.2 crore to be spent over the remaining project tenure. Under Companies Act Section 135 and Rule 4(6)/7 of CSR Rules, which treatment of the unspent INR 1.2 crore is CORRECT?

answer.text: The INR 1.2 crore must be deposited in PM CARES Fund within 30 days of year-end — ongoing-project treatment is not allowed
The INR 1.2 crore lapses and cannot be carried forward under any circumstances
The INR 1.2 crore is automatically added to next year's CSR budget without any separate account requirement
The INR 1.2 crore, being attributable to an ongoing project, must be transferred to an 'Unspent CSR Account' within 30 days of year-end and utilised within 3 financial years

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 135(6) of the Companies Act 2013, read with Rule 4(6)/7 of the Companies (CSR Policy) Rules, treats unspent CSR amounts pursuant to an ongoing project differently from other unspent CSR. The unspent amount for an ongoing project must be transferred to a separate "Unspent CSR Account" in a scheduled bank within 30 days of the end of the financial year and used for the project within three financial years. Non-ongoing-project unspent amounts, by contrast, go directly to a Schedule VII fund within six months. The INR 1.2 crore in this fact pattern is tied to an ongoing project and therefore follows the Unspent CSR Account route. The Trap: A direct PM CARES transfer is the rule for non-ongoing-project unspent CSR or for amounts that remain unspent after the three-year window — not the first-step treatment for ongoing projects. "Lapses entirely" contradicts the carry-forward design. "Auto addition to next year's CSR budget" skips both the separate-account and the three-year deadline. Note: The Social Impact Assessors workbook discusses CSR pay-for-success grants and Schedule VII activities on the cited pages, but does not spell out the Section 135(6) Unspent CSR Account mechanism — the 30-day transfer window and the three-financial-year utilisation rule. That framing is drawn from the Companies Act 2013 and the CSR Rules rather than from the workbook pages checked.
